ai-explainer-reel.when: vertical talking head, 20-120 s, topic is AI / tech / money / side hustle / how-to
graphics: prompt box for any prompt said aloud
full-screen paper chapter card on a key line
ai-explainer-reel.layout: split-stack: graphic top 45%, face bottom 55%; something changes every 2-4 s
ai-explainer-reel.look: Clean Paper (user's choice 2026-11-27): off-white panels, black text, blue buttons, yellow highlighter. No glow, no 3D, no aurora.

talking-head-reel.when: vertical talking head on any other topic (motivation, lifestyle, story, opinion)
graphics: chapter word cards for each key point
talking-head-reel.layout: full-face with punch-ins; full-frame graphics for 1.5-2.5 s at each key point

tutorial-long.when: horizontal, > 3 min, screen recording or demo content
tutorial-long.layout: screen recordings in bubble mode (face cam bottom-left); zoom on the UI being discussed

talking-head-long.when: horizontal talking head, > 3 min, little screen content
talking-head-long.layout: punch-in every other sentence; B-roll or graphic at least every 20-30 s

podcast-clip.when: horizontal, two people or interview, cut down to a vertical clip
graphics: title on frame 1 with the clip's claim
podcast-clip.layout: crop to the active speaker (set face_x per section), captions large

cinematic-montage.when: little or no speech (B-roll, travel, product, event footage)
cinematic-montage.layout: cut on bars/beats (montage.py), slow push-ins, no talking-head rules

product-launch.when: product / app / SaaS launch, feature reveal, demo with hype
product-launch.layout: fast cuts on beats, full-frame graphics between shots
